{{Top|leg}}
An '''auto-hypodermic''' was a small, self-filling [[Hypodermic injector/Legends|hypodermic injector]] that drew from a chemical reservoir. [[MedCo]] produced one of the cheaper versions on the market, the [[Auto-6 Hypodermic Sleeve]]. Auto-hypodermics were an integral part of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] [[Animal Restraining Bolt]].
